record.paper_title: INPUT-TO-STATE STABILITY OF INFINITE-DIMENSIONAL SYSTEMS: RECENT RESULTS AND OPEN QUESTIONS
record.original_question: Clarify the relationships between the various small-gain conditions used for infinite networks of interconnected systems, such as spectral small-gain conditions, robust strong small-gain conditions, existence of Ω-paths, and monotone invertibility of id − Γ. Use that understanding to derive input-to-state stability small-gain theorems for infinite networks with nonlinear gains.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 6.12. Small-gain results presented in this section use various types of the small-gain conditions: spectral small-gain condition [123], robust strong small-gain condition [53], existence of a so-called Ω-path for a gain operator Γ [53], as well as “monotone invertibility” of id −Γ [164]. The relations between these conditions are known for finite networks, but are unclear for infinite networks. Understanding of these relationships and using of this knowledge to obtain ISS small-gain theorems for infinite networks with nonlinear gains is a challenging open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider an infinite network of interconnected control systems indexed by a countable set $I$. Each subsystem $\Sigma_i$ has state $x_i$ in some Banach space, an external input $u_i$, and is interconnected with the other subsystems through nonlinear gains $\gamma_{ij}\in\mathcal{K}_\infty\cup\{0\}$ that quantify the influence of $x_j$ on $x_i$. Assume each $\Sigma_i$ is input-to-state stable (ISS) with respect to its inputs and to the states of its neighbors, with gains $\gamma_{ij}$.

Form the (in general infinite-dimensional) nonlinear monotone gain operator
$$\Gamma:\ell_+^\infty(I)	o \ell_+^\infty(I),\qquad \Gamma(s)_i=\sup_{j\in I}\gamma_{ij}(s_j),$$
and consider the following candidate small-gain conditions on $\Gamma$:

(a) Spectral small-gain condition: $r(\Gamma)<1$ in an appropriate spectral-radius sense for monotone (sub-)linear maps.

(b) Robust strong small-gain condition: there exists $ho\in\mathcal{K}_\infty$ such that $D_ho\circ\Gamma$ has a suitable global stability property, where $D_ho(s)=((\mathrm{id}+ho)(s_i))_i$.

(c) Existence of an $\Omega$-path: a continuous, componentwise strictly increasing path $\sigma:[0,\infty)	o\ell_+^\infty(I)$ with $\sigma(0)=0$, $\sigma(r)	o\infty$ as $r	o\infty$, such that $\Gamma(\sigma(r))<\sigma(r)$ componentwise for all $r>0$.

(d) Monotone invertibility of $\mathrm{id}-\Gamma$: for every $w\in\ell_+^\infty(I)$, the inequality $v\le \Gamma(v)+w$ implies $v\le\chi(\|w\|)\mathbf{1}$ for some $\chi\in\mathcal{K}_\infty$ (equivalently a monotone bounded invertibility property of $\mathrm{id}-\Gamma$).

Problem. (i) Determine the precise logical relationships (implications, equivalences, and counterexamples) among conditions (a)–(d) for infinite networks (it is known that for finite networks under standard assumptions they are essentially equivalent). (ii) Using these relationships, formulate and prove ISS small-gain theorems for infinite networks of interconnected ISS systems with general nonlinear gains $\gamma_{ij}$, giving conditions on $\Gamma$ that guarantee ISS of the whole interconnection (in trajectory and/or Lyapunov form).
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made since the question was posed. Kawan, Mironchenko, Noroozi, Schwenninger, Zamani and collaborators (e.g., "Nonlinear small-gain theorems for ISS of infinite interconnections", MCSS 2021/2022; "A Lyapunov-based ISS small-gain theorem for infinite networks of nonlinear systems", arXiv:2103.07439; "ISS small-gain criteria for infinite networks with linear gains", 2021; and "The small-gain condition for infinite networks modeled on $\ell^\infty$-spaces", arXiv:2503.03925) have clarified key relationships: the monotone limit property, uniform small-gain condition, and monotone bounded invertibility of $\mathrm{id}-\Gamma$ are equivalent in broad settings, and existence of a path of strict decay (Ω-path) yields trajectory- and Lyapunov-based ISS small-gain theorems for countable networks. However, the full picture (including the spectral small-gain condition and general nonlinear gains over arbitrary state spaces) is not yet completely settled, so the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Nonlinear small-gain theorems for input-to-state stability of infinite interconnections
status_evidence.snippet: Extends nonlinear small-gain theorems for ISS from finite to countably infinite networks; relates monotone limit property, uniform small-gain condition, and bounded invertibility of id − Γ.
status_evidence.claim: Significant partial resolution of the relationships and ISS small-gain theorems for infinite networks with nonlinear gains.

status_evidence.title: A Lyapunov-based ISS small-gain theorem for infinite networks of nonlinear systems
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs ISS Lyapunov functions for infinite networks under a path-of-strict-decay/Ω-path-type condition on the gain operator.
status_evidence.claim: Lyapunov-based ISS small-gain theorem proved for infinite networks via Ω-path-type conditions.

status_evidence.title: The small-gain condition for infinite networks modeled on ℓ^∞-spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) study clarifying small-gain conditions for gain operators on ℓ^∞-type spaces in the infinite-network setting.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing recent work continues to refine relationships between small-gain conditions for infinite networks.
